hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked SUV near the corner obscures the view between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Trash and bags are piled on the sidewalk, creating a minor obstruction and tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Blank Wall Frontage
hazards.description: A long stretch of windowless wall reduces natural surveillance and makes the environment feel less safe for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: A long stretch of windowless wall reduces 'eyes on the street' and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to provide a clear, ADA-compliant path of travel that accommodates both pedestrians and mature trees.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven sections of the sidewalk to provide a smooth and accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a small planting strip to create a buffer between the sidewalk and the street, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove weeds to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures like speed humps or curb extensions to manage vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening
interventions.description: Reconfigure the sidewalk around the mature trees to ensure a minimum clear path of 4-5 feet.

interventions.title: Pedestrian lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and safety after dark, as no lighting is currently visible.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to increase separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk storage areas for waste containers to ensure the full width of the walkway remains clear.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is present to improve safety and security during evening hours.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement policies or community programs to ensure sidewalks remain clear of large debris and household items to maintain accessibility for all users, including those with mobility aids.
interventions.source: NACTO Urban Street Design Guide - Sidewalks

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Shared Street Treatment
interventions.description: If sidewalks cannot be added, implement a shared street design with traffic calming and clear signage to prioritize pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the damaged pavement with a smooth, continuous concrete surface to eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Alley Safety Measures
interventions.description: Install warning signs or a convex mirror to improve visibility at the blind corner where the alley meets the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage the installation of windows or public art/murals on the blank wall to improve the pedestrian experience and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center line and parking lane markings to narrow the perceived travel lane and encourage slower vehicle speeds.
